title: Pakistan Calls Israel's Refusal to Withdraw from Gaza a 'Serious Setback'
detail: Pakistan publicly condemned Israel's refusal to withdraw forces from Gaza, describing it as a 'serious setback' to peace efforts. Islamabad's statement adds a prominent Muslim-world diplomatic voice to growing international pressure on stalled ceasefire negotiations, signaling broader solidarity against Israel's continued military presence.

media.caption: Pakistan condemns Israel's refusal to withdraw from Gaza as a serious setback to peace
